author: Leaff
quote: Brings nothing new to the table, no innovation. GTA 6 feels like someone asked AI to upscale GTA 5 textures and forgot to tell the AI to add basic features any modern game has, like an autosave. Every environmental texture looks like a low-quality PNG and unrealistic up close, and the quality of the character models feels like 2011 Alice: Madness Returns, with the super floppy hair. This game is the worst example of graphics over gameplay.

author: Leaff
quote: I don’t get why this game got so much hate. I think that it was a very good game. It was beautiful! One of the best looking games I’ve EVER seen. I think one of the reasons people hated this game is homophobia, i’m not a homosexual or anything but it doesn’t mean the game is bad. It was good. Give it a shot, and stop listing to all the reviews of people who never played the game.
